subject: exeuctor: fix goroutine leak when handleForeignKeyCascade exceed mem_quota (#49885)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent. `ExecStmt.handleForeignKeyCascade` now always calls `exec.Close` even when `exec.Next` returns an error, and `exec.Next` now recovers panics into errors so cascade execution can still reach `Close` (preventing goroutine leaks on error/panic paths); tests were adjusted accordingly. No Blocker/High issues found in executor correctness/concurrency/txn/session behavior within the touched scope; later history up to `upstream/master` retains the same approach.
